name: Tenvow Movie Review & Rating
author: Abdul Kadir

sections.description:
Tenvow Movie Review & Rating is a lightweight WordPress plugin for movie and film review sites. Add an Editor’s Rating (0–10), automatic verdict (Excellent, Good, Average…), and valid Movie + Review JSON-LD schema so search engines can show rich review snippets.

Built by Tenvow for publishers who need clean on-page ratings and SEO-friendly structured data—without bloat.

Why use this plugin?

  • Movie review rating box on every post — simple, readable, conversion-friendly
  • Editor’s Rating out of 10 with automatic verdict labels
  • Valid Movie + Review schema (JSON-LD) for Google, Bing, and AI search
  • SEO & AI Search optimized structured data using your post author, excerpt, and site name
  • Lightweight & fast — no external libraries, no tracking, no ads
  • Works with Rank Math and other SEO plugins without duplicating Organization/WebSite schema

Free features

  • Enable/disable review per post
  • Movie name, rating (1–10), director, cast, release date fields
  • On-page Editor’s Rating summary box with verdict
  • Automatic Movie + Review schema markup in the page head
  • Settings page with optional “delete data on uninstall”

Free vs Pro

  • Rating score & verdict — Free ✅ · Pro ✅
  • Basic rating box — Free ✅ · Pro ✅
  • Full rich review card — Free ❌ · Pro ✅
  • Movie poster on card — Free ❌ · Pro ✅
  • Movie title on card — Free ❌ · Pro ✅
  • Director on card — Free ❌ · Pro ✅
  • Cast on card — Free ❌ · Pro ✅
  • Release date on card — Free ❌ · Pro ✅
  • Theme selection (Default / Light / Dark) — Free ❌ · Pro ✅
  • Movie + Review schema (JSON-LD) — Free ✅ · Pro ✅
  • SEO & AI Search optimized — Free ✅ · Pro ✅
  • Lightweight & fast — Free ✅ · Pro ✅

Try Pro free for 3 days

Tenvow Movie Review & Rating Pro adds a full rich review card (poster, title, director, cast, release date) and Default / Light / Dark themes.

Try Pro free for 3 days — no payment method required.

Pro is optional. The free version stays fully functional on its own.

Documentation

Full setup guide: Movie Review & Rating plugin documentation
sections.installation:
1. Install Tenvow Movie Review & Rating from Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Edit any post → open the Tenvow Movie Review box in the sidebar.
  4. Check Enable Tenvow Review, fill Movie Name and Editor’s Rating (required for the box and schema).
  5. Publish or update — the rating box and schema appear automatically.
sections.faq:
Does this work on pages or custom post types?

Currently standard posts only.

What if I leave the rating empty?

The review box and schema are not output until a rating is set and the review is enabled.

Does uninstalling remove my data?

By default, no. Go to Settings → Tenvow Movie Review and check Delete data on uninstall if you want a clean removal.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. Pro adds a rich review card (poster, title, director, cast, release date) and three themes (Default, Light, Dark). Try Pro free for 3 days.

Does it conflict with Rank Math or other SEO plugins?

No. It only outputs Movie / Review / Rating schema and does not replace Organization, WebSite, or WebPage schema from other plugins.

Where can I get support or documentation?

Documentation: https://tenvow.com/movie-review-rating-plugin-documentation/
Website: Tenvow
